contract_equivalence.note: Explicit, version-aware translation between the v3 active contract and this v4 proposal. Used for (a) rendering historical rows under current numbering WITHOUT silently reinterpreting an old id, and (b) evidence reuse: a v3 row is reusable as its v4 gate ONLY when criteria are contract-equal (ROT: thresholds unchanged) AND build/setfile/window hashes match.

storage_strategy.work_items_phase: TEXT, no CHECK (verified census farmctl.py:1589) -> new v4 ids may be written without a table migration.
storage_strategy.discriminator_column: gate_contract_version (NEW, add to work_items). Every row is read only under its own contract version; a v3 'Q10' is NEVER read as v4 'Q10'. Backfill: rows written on/after 2026-08-23 = 'v3'; earlier per pipeline_version, else 'legacy'.
storage_strategy.dependency_role_check: work_item_dependencies.dependency_role CHECK is enforced (q09_news_schema.py:191-196). v4 activation requires a table-rebuild migration widening the CHECK to the UNION of v3 and v4 tokens (append-only, old tokens retained for historical reads). SQLite cannot ALTER a CHECK.
storage_strategy.reuse_equivalence: Q00-Q08 ids unchanged -> historical rows reuse directly. Phase-2/3 gates reuse via contract_equivalence.v3_to_v4 only when contract-equal + hash-bound.

requires_all.detail: COUNT(candidates whose highest_contiguous_valid_gate == Q14 with terminal requalification verdict) >= 25. Canonical unit = (EA, Symbol); ALSO report distinct EAs and distinct strategy families.
A verified OWNER book-build order at decisions/YYYY-MM-DD_owner_book_order_<venue>.md, venue in {dxz, ftmo}.

book_trigger.on_unmet: REFUSE (raise), never skip; under 25 only measure/complete the pool, never construct a probe book.
book_trigger.supersedes: The old Q11 auto-trigger at 5 Q10 pairs is void (already absent in code; now explicitly forbidden).

backfill_planner_contract.ordering_global: FRONTIER_FIRST (rank pairs by highest_contiguous_valid_gate descending so shortest-remaining candidates complete first)
backfill_planner_contract.ordering_per_pair: EARLIEST_MISSING_PREREQUISITE_FIRST (walk the shallowest missing/invalid gate; never enqueue a gate above an unfilled hole)
backfill_planner_contract.dedup: Skip exact build+setfile+window+contract-hash-equal evidence; globally dedup identical economic runs.
backfill_planner_contract.terminal_economic_fail: No backfill behind a terminal economic FAIL unless a separately authorized rebuild/new experiment changes the tested identity.
backfill_planner_contract.repairable: INFRA / STALE / contract-gap rows may be repaired and rerun.
backfill_planner_contract.enqueue_binding: Every enqueue binds gate_contract_version + build hash + setfile hash + data window + parent evidence sha256.
backfill_planner_contract.progress_metric: highest_contiguous_valid_gate (NOT the largest observed Qxx string).
